newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai to issue loan registration cards to firms.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai to issue loan registration cards to firms.

text.p: Shanghai will issue loan registration cards to local companies from January 1 next year, requiring the holders to register each loan transaction, the Shanghai Securities News said on Sunday.

Shanghai-registered firms or companies from other areas which have been given permission to apply for loans in the city will have a card, the paper said, quoting a recent announcement by the Shanghai branch of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The firms must show the cards and register each time for a transaction and the cards will be subject to annual checks, the paper said.

Those firms found to use the cards improperly will be punished and those which use the cards for illegal dealings will have the card and rights for applying for loans revoked, the paper said, but gave no details.
The paper said the move was aimed at more effective control over the use of loans.
